name: FreeRice
description_short: A vocabulary trivia game where each correct answer triggers a rice donation to the UN World Food Programme — quick multiple-choice rounds with a genuine real-world hook to discuss.
teacher_note: Good filler with a talking point built in — after a round, ask the student about the cause itself, not just the vocab.
creator: Freerice / World Food Programme
internal_notes: Verified live: free to play immediately with no login. cefr_level set specific A2-C1 based on the general-vocabulary difficulty range described by the site (adaptive difficulty, multiple subjects) rather than a single fixed level. age_group left unknown — no stated audience restriction.
